summary: Remote-agent runtime with obfuscated WebSocket-driven shell/PTY execution and self-replacement
details: The package's bin `whalent-core` resolves to `dist/index.cjs`, a 14 MB fully obfuscated bundle (obfuscator.io string-array + rotation + control-flow flattening) that imports `ws`, `child_process` (spawn/execFile), and optional `node-pty`, and contains handler strings including `onData`, `onMessage`, `shell`, `reverse`, `/ws/`, `register`, `heartbeat`, and `token`. The bundle also contains `update`/`upgrade`/`replace`/`writeFile` co-located with the WebSocket handlers, and the README states the package `is the package replaced by remote daemon upgrades`, giving the remote endpoint a path to push replacement code onto the installer host. Loopback endpoints `127.0.0.1:3389` (RDP) and `127.0.0.1:5900`/`5901` (VNC) also appear as string literals, usable as tunnel targets over the same channel. The destination host is reconstructed at runtime from the rotated string array and is not recoverable from the shipped bundle, so the party that controls the local PTY/shell cannot be inspected before install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
